requirement:
调整支付流程和订票保存服务的代码细节。
支付服务和订票服务之间的数据传递需要优化。
需要检查支付完成后通知订单的逻辑。

details.name: ts-inside-payment-service
details.rationale: Handles internal payment processing and likely interacts with ts-payment-service for payment completion.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order service receives payment notifications and updates order status, directly affected by payment flow changes.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Handles other order types and may also receive payment completion notifications.

details.name: ts-preserve-service
details.rationale: Preservation service may trigger payments and needs to align with updated payment data flow.

details.name: ts-preserve-other-service
details.rationale: Similar to preserve-service, may interact with payment for other ticket types.

details.name: ts-notification-service
details.rationale: May send payment-related notifications after payment completion, requiring logic updates.

details.name: ts-cancel-service
details.rationale: Cancellation flow may involve payment refunds and could be affected by payment data changes.

details.name: ts-rebook-service
details.rationale: Rebooking may involve payment adjustments and could depend on payment service changes.
